reply_text:
I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on **November 3, 2025**.

- **Source for the date:** Moss's Coastal digest of 2025-11-02 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's own cutover recap note from 2025-12-08 gives the same official date.
- **Day-to-day takeover:** Bettina's recap says she kept running the account day to day until Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use Nov 22 only if the tracker wants the working takeover date instead of the official one.
